caption: The drawing features a stylized floral design rendered in black ink on an off-white background. The central element consists of a round flower head formed by nine circular shapes arranged in a ring, each filled with tight, radiating spiral lines. Inside the ring of circular shapes, there are smaller circles, also filled with spiral lines, clustered together to form the flower's center. At the top of the flower head, three elongated, leaf-like shapes extend outward, each outlined with a braid-like pattern and filled with a row of small circles. A single stem extends downward from the flower head, connecting to two long, pointed, symmetrical leaves, each similarly outlined and filled with small circles in a row. The overall composition is symmetrical, and all elements are depicted using only black lines and shapes on the light background.
title: Needlework
